title: Instruction-Tuning Large Language Models with Medical Classification Data Improves ICD Coding of German Tumor Diagnoses
abstract: arXiv:2510.13624v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate coding of tumor diagnoses with ICD-10-GM and ICD-O-3 is essential for structured cancer documentation in Germany. Smaller open-weight LLMs are appealing for privacy-preserving automation but often struggle with coding accuracy in German-language contexts. This study investigates whether instruction-based fine-tuning on public datasets improves the coding accuracy of open-weight LLMs for German tumor diagnosis texts. The evaluation uses coded diagnoses from the local tumor documentation system as test data. In a systematic data quality assessment, the upper limit for ICD-10 coding performance was estimated at 60-79% for exact and 81-94% for partial (three-character codes only) derivation. As training data, over 500,000 question-answer pairs were created based on the ICD-10-GM, ICD-O-3, and OPS catalogues. translated_title: 使用医学分类数据对大语言模型进行指令微调可提升德语肿瘤诊断的ICD编码准确性
translated_abstract: 使用ICD-10-GM和ICD-O-3对肿瘤诊断进行准确编码，对于德国结构化癌症文档记录至关重要。较小的开源权重大语言模型在隐私保护自动化方面具有吸引力，但在德语语境中往往难以达到编码准确性。本研究探讨了基于公开数据集的指令微调能否提高开源权重大语言模型对德语肿瘤诊断文本的编码准确性。评估采用来自本地肿瘤文档系统的已编码诊断作为测试数据。在系统性数据质量评估中，ICD-10编码性能的上限估计为：精确编码为60-79%，部分编码（仅三位字符编码）为81-94%。作为训练数据，研究者基于ICD-10-GM、ICD-O-3和OPS目录创建了超过50万个问答对，并对来自Qwen、Llama和Mistral系列的八个开源权重模型（7-70B参数）进行了微调。ICD-10-GM a…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究基于ICD-10-GM、ICD-O-3和OPS医学分类目录构建了超过50万个问答对，对Qwen、Llama和Mistral系列开源大语言模型进行指令微调，从而显著提升了德语肿瘤诊断文本的ICD编码准确性。
en_tdlr: Instruction-tuning eight open-weight LLMs (7-70B, from Qwen, Llama, and Mistral families) with over 500,000 question-answer pairs generated from ICD-10-GM, ICD-O-3, and OPS catalogues improves the coding accuracy of German tumor diagnoses.
